description: List what a mapped UK hospital's map holds: its entrances, wards, departments and clinics, facilities (reception, pharmacy, food, toilets) and other places, each with where it is and a directions link. Optionally only one kind.

hospital.description: The hospital's name, e.g. 'Great Ormond Street Hospital' or 'St George's Hospital, Tooting'. A town helps when names are shared.

name: list_places
title: List a hospital's places
